annotations.exact_quote: A semi-supervised deep hashing network is designed to extensively exploit both labeled and unlabeled data
annotations.reason_zh: 明确构建半监督深度哈希网络，同时利用有标注与无标注数据，符合结合有限监督与未标注样本的半监督学习定义。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose an online graph construction method to benefit from the evolving deep features during training to better capture semantic neighbors
annotations.reason_zh: 提出在线图构建方法，利用训练中演化的深度特征学习/修正样本间图结构以捕捉语义邻居。

annotations.exact_quote: semi-supervised loss to jointly minimize the empirical error on labeled data, as well as the embedding error on both labeled and unlabeled data, which can preserve the semantic similarity and capture the meaningful neighbors on the underlying data structures
annotations.reason_zh: 半监督损失在无标注数据上利用底层结构和邻居关系施加嵌入误差，以保持语义相似与几何一致性，符合图/流形正则化定义。

annotations.exact_quote: We propose a semi-supervised loss to jointly minimize the empirical error on labeled data, as well as the embedding error on both labeled and unlabeled data
annotations.reason_zh: 方法以同时使用有标注与无标注数据的半监督损失为核心，缺失实例标签的不完整监督是实质研究条件，也符合独立的弱监督词定义。
